response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), shares AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), results AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM shares) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation FROM results ORDER BY deviation IS NULL, deviation DESC, arcref ASC LIMIT 10
